31924-B.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adjusting expenditure, revenue and commitment amounts and sets the commitment amount for the general and supplementary grants at 14,737,304,000 euros. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: This concerns a positive difference of 77,346,000 euros. The reason is that as long as the distribution factor 1 is not final, payments to municipalities may deviate from what the budget states.

Het gaat hierbij om een verschil van € 77 346 000 (positief). De reden van het verschil ligt in het feit dat zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken.

32360-G.s: This bill is the final budget adjustment act (slotwet) for the BTW-compensatiefonds for 2009, changing the 2009 budget statement to reflect realised spending and receipts. It amends the budget figures in euro thousands and takes effect the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Thus it is that We, in common consultation with the States General, have decided and resolved, as We hereby decide and resolve
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze

32565-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget of the Ministry of Youth and Family by adopting a second supplementary budget statement (Najaarsnota) with adjusted appropriations. It also assigns, for 2010 only and from 14 October 2010, management responsibility for the Youth and Family budget to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport in agreement with the Ministers of Justice and Social Affairs, departing from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
32565-XVII.j: The memorandum of explanation is missing, so no justification is given for the change in budget management responsibility.
q: For the year 2010, notwithstanding Article 19a(2) of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, from 14 October 2010 the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport, in agreement with the Ministers of Justice and Social Affairs, is responsible for managing the Youth and Family budget.

Voor het jaar 2010 geldt dat in afwijking van artikel 19a, tweede lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 vanaf 14 oktober 2010 Onze Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en Onze Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid, verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer van de begroting van Jeugd en Gezin.
p: For 2010 only, budget management responsibility for Youth and Family is transferred to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport in agreement with two other ministers, departing from the standard rule of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

32780-A.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2011 by changing appropriations and revenues across budget articles, as a supplementary budget following the spring memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2011, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement belonging to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

33090-F.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), adjusting expenditure and revenue lines for article 1 (animal disease control and welfare) in line with the Najaarsnota. It also sets the fund's figures in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force at 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33240-I.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Royal Household (Koning I), adjusting spending and commitment figures in thousands of euros for the 2011 budget year, with retroactive effect to 31 December of that year. The explanatory memorandum notes a small upward adjustment of 8 thousand euros to the allowances for members of the royal family due to price developments.
33240-I.j: The memorandum justifies the 8 thousand euro increase by reference to price developments that differed from those assumed when the budget was drawn up.
q: Because price developments deviated somewhat from what was assumed when the budget was drawn up, the budget amount is increased by 8.
Doordat de prijsontwikkeling enigszins afwijkt van datgene waarmee bij het opstellen van de begroting rekening is gehouden, wordt het begrotingsbedrag met 8 verhoogd.

33480-C.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting new commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants and revising the expenditure and receipts schedule. It takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for general grants is set for 2012 at €486,686,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) terzake van de algemene uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2012 vastgesteld op € 486 686 000.

33750-C.s: The bill fixes the 2014 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at 1,171,987 thousand euros, including commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It sets the entry into force on 1 January 2014 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant etc. is set for grant year 2014 at € 345,268,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2014 vastgesteld op € 345.268.000.

33805-B.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and fixing commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants. It also sets the entry-into-force date of the amendment, which may be made retroactive to 1 December 2013.
33805-B.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by explaining that until the uitkeringsfactor is final, payments to municipalities can differ from the budgeted amounts.
q: as long as the uitkeringsfactor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to the municipalities may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

33930-C.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by setting the final commitment, expenditure and receipt figures, with a slotwet adjustment of minus 79 thousand euro in commitments and minus 7 thousand euro in expenditure and receipts. It also fixes the 2013 commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet, effective the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
33930-C.j: The memorandum explains the small difference as arising because the uitkeringsfactor is not yet final, so payments to provinces may differ from the budgeted amounts, due to differences between estimated and actual distribution criteria.
q: as long as the uitkeringsfactor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to the provinces may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de provincies kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

33940-B.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and fixing commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It takes effect from 1 June 2014, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
33940-B.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by the need to adjust the 2014 municipal fund budget, linked to the Voorjaarsnota, and describes allocations for new municipal tasks (VTH, kostendelersnorm, mantelzorg).
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2014
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2014

34085-A.s: The bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across transport infrastructure articles. It takes effect on 1 December 2014 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2014
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2014

34725-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement (slotwet) for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), setting out the adjusted budget totals and policy-article figures in thousands of euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34950-XVII.s: This slotwet amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), setting out the original budget, supplementary budgets, realisation and closing adjustments per policy article. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no shift of power to the executive.
q: Less was spent on NUFFIC because part of the new programme was still in preparation and did not lead to a payment in 2017.
Er is minder uitgegeven aan NUFFIC omdat een deel van het nieuwe programma nog in voorbereiding was en niet tot een betaling in 2017 heeft geleid.

35210-J.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds by adjusting expenditure and revenue across its articles, effective from 1 June 2019. The explanatory memorandum lists the budget shifts and project-level changes and contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2019
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2019

35300-J.s: This bill fixes the 2020 budget statement (expenditure, commitments and receipts) of the Deltafonds, the Dutch flood-protection and freshwater fund, in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date and is a purely budgetary act with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The budget statement for the Deltafonds under Article 7.22a of the Water Act, attached to this law, is established for the year 2020.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het deltafonds, genoemd in artikel 7.22a van de Waterwet, voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division raised no substantive objections to the 2020 Deltafund budget bill and advised submission, with only redactional remarks in an annex. The Minister of Finance replied in a nader rapport, accepting the redactional changes and enclosing budget amendments in appendices.
concerns: The advisory division proposed redactional changes to the considerans and article 1 referring to the Waterwet and Deltawet waterveiligheid en zoetwatervoorziening instead of the old Deltawet citation.

35470-B.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) in its final adjustment (Slotwet), setting the 2019 commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and for integration and decentralisation grants. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the act effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
35470-B.j: The memorandum explains that the difference between budgeted and paid amounts arises because the distribution factor is not yet final, and that the general grant budget will be adjusted upward in the Voorjaarsnota 2020.
q: The expenditure budget for the general grant will be adjusted upward by this amount in the Voorjaarsnota 2020 so that the payments can still take place.
Het uitgavenbudget voor de algemene uitkering zal bij Voorjaarsnota 2020 met dit bedrag opwaarts worden bijgesteld, zodat de betalingen alsnog plaats kunnen vinden.

35570-A.s: This bill formally establishes the 2021 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund, setting expenditure, commitment and revenue amounts in thousands of euros for road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project items. It also sets the entry-into-force rules, with the act effective 1 January 2021 or retroactively from that date if published later.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund attached to this act, referred to in article 2 of the Infrastructure Fund Act, is hereby established for the year 2021.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Infrastructuurfonds, voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bill for the Infrastructuurfonds and raised no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport, which covers the batch of 2021 budget advices and notes one non-blank advice on the Ministry of Finance budget, is included.

35650-B.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by raising the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and for the integration and decentralisation grants, with effect from 1 December 2020. It is a second supplementary budget, adjusting spending amounts for municipalities without shifting powers between government bodies.
q: The budget statement of the municipal fund for 2020 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35830-B.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) to record the final figures after the first and second supplementary budgets, setting the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants for 2020. It makes the amended statement effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
35830-B.j: The memorandum justifies the budget adjustment by explaining that payments to municipalities can differ from the budgeted amount until the allocation factor is final, with the general grant to be adjusted upward in the Voorjaarsnota 2021.
q: as long as the allocation factor is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities may deviate from the budget stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor niet definitief is, de omvang van de betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken van het budget dat in de begroting vermeld staat

35850-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 May 2021.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2021
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII), voor het jaar 2021

36100-K.s: This Slotwet amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (Hoofdstuk K), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across material categories. The explanatory memorandum explains the variances mainly as delayed contracts, technical and bookkeeping adjustments, and small project deviations.
36100-K.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes as technical execution adjustments, bookkeeping effects and delayed contracts rather than any new powers.
q: This bill includes technical execution adjustments, bookkeeping-type changes, and changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

36120-I.s: The bill amends the 2022 state budget for the Royal Household (begrotingsstaat van de Koning) through a first supplementary budget, with small increases in expenditure for functional costs and a revenue change for article 1. The explanatory memorandum explains the changes as budget adjustments and wage and price indexation, with no transfer of powers.
q: The multi-year expenditure changes under article 2 concern the wage and price adjustment for 2022.
De meerjarige uitgavenmutaties op artikel 2 betreffen de loon- en prijsbijstelling 2022.

36200-J.s: The bill formally adopts the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the Deltafonds, setting expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros, and takes effect on 1 January 2023. It is a budgetary act with annexed financial tables and the memorandum describes an experimentation provision allowing Deltafonds spending on other policy areas with additional funding.
q: The budget statement for the Deltafonds, referred to in article 7.22a of the Waterwet, belonging to this act, is established for the year 2023.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het Deltafonds, genoemd in artikel 7.22a van de Waterwet, voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering has no remarks on the 2023 Deltafonds budget bill (begrotingsstaat) and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport informs the King that some budgets require amendments, referring to annexes not included in the text.

36360-C.s: This slotwet amends the 2022 budget of the provinciefonds, fixing the commitment amount for the general grant at €2,757,786,000 and the decentralisation grants at €75,557,000. It records the final budget realisation figures, with a small slotwet adjustment, and takes effect the day after publication.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is fixed for grant year 2022 at €2,757,786,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2022 vastgesteld op € 2.757.786.000.

36435-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), changing expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros following the supplementary budget on Prinsjesdag. It is made retroactive to 19 September 2023 and enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2023 is amended
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd

36470-A.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, waterway and other infrastructure items. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2023.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management for the year 2023
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat voor het jaar 2023

36550-B.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by a first supplementary budget, adding about 603 million euro to commitments and 465 million euro to expenditure and revenue. It also sets the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants for 2024, and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2024.
q: The 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36560-A.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds) through the Slotwet, adjusting commitments, expenditures and revenues across transport infrastructure articles. It is a technical budget adjustment with no delegation of rule-making or new executive powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, changes of an accounting nature, or changes arising from audit findings.
– In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevin dingen opgenomen;

36597-(R2198).s: The bill approves for Curaçao a 2023 tax treaty with San Marino on avoiding double taxation of income and preventing tax evasion and avoidance. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The Treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands, for the benefit of Curaçao, and the Republic of San Marino for the avoidance of double taxation concluded at San Marino on 20 November 2023
Het op 20 november 2023 te San Marino tot stand gekomen Verdrag tussen het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden, ten behoeve van Curaçao, en de Republiek San Marino tot het vermijden van dubbele belasting

parties: Questions the purpose and economic justification of the treaty with San Marino and whether Curaçao's treaty network expansion is a goal in itself.
These members therefore ask what exactly the purpose is and how the absence of treaties is now causing bottlenecks.
Deze leden vragen daarom wat precies het doel is en hoe het ontbreken van verdragen nu voor knelpunten zorgt.
Asks about the criteria for extending the treaty to other parts of the Kingdom, whether parliamentary approval is required, and why answers to 2018 questions were delayed five years.
Can the government further explain which criteria apply to extending the treaty? Must this extension also be approved by the States General?
Kan de regering nader toelichten welke criteria gelden voor uitbreiding van het verdrag? Dient deze uitbreiding ook door de Staten-Generaal te worden goedgekeurd?
Sees no added value in the treaty given the lack of meaningful economic relations and suspects it serves to address grey- and black-list status rather than real economic needs.
The NSC members do not see the added value of a tax treaty between Curaçao and San Marino.
De leden van de NSC-fractie zien de meerwaarde van een belastingverdrag tussen Curaçao en San Marino niet in.
The PNP says the treaty does not respect Curaçao's fiscal autonomy and asks detailed questions about privacy safeguards, information exchange and enforcement.
In the process of the present draft rijkswet on the San Marino Treaty, the fracties does not believe respect for Curaçao's fiscal autonomy is shown.
In het proces van het onderhavige voorstel van rijkswet Verdrag San Marino, wordt het respect voor de fiscale autonomie van Curaçao niet getoond, naar de mening van de fractie.
The MAN supports treaties to avoid double taxation but wants careful review against misuse and asks for quantified benefits.
On the other hand, care must be taken that such treaties are not misused, and therefore they must be examined carefully, but with a constructive view.
Aan de andere kant moet ervoor worden gewaakt dat dit soort verdragen niet worden misbruikt en juist daarom moet zorgvuldig hiernaar worden gekeken, maar toch met een constructieve blik.
The MFK complains that the Netherlands second-guesses Curaçao's economic relations and asks that the benefits of the treaty be explained.
It is important that the government explains in detail the benefits of the treaty with San Marino.
Het is belangrijk dat de regering de voordelen uitvoerig uiteenzet van de voordelen uit het verdrag met San Marino.
The PAR asks about the treaty's effects on the banking, offshore, online gaming and financial sectors and expects other Kingdom countries to ratify it.
What possible negative consequences could this treaty have for our financial-economic sector?
Welke mogelijke negatieve gevolgen kan dit verdrag hebben voor onze financieel-economische sector?
The independent member asks what San Marino means for Curaçao, what the government's vision is and how the population can benefit.
First of all, it is important to know what San Marino means for Curaçao.
Allereerst is het belangrijk te weten wat San Marino voor Curaçao betekent.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State of the Kingdom gave advice on a tax treaty between the Kingdom of the Netherlands (for Curaçao) and San Marino, concluding it had no remarks and advised submitting the treaty to the States General and the Staten of Curaçao. The text is a transmittal letter from the Minister of Foreign Affairs proposing a rijkswet for express approval after 44 Tweede Kamer members requested it, and it contains no government reply to any Afdeling point.

36613-B.s: The bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment and expenditure amounts for the general and supplementary grants and the integration and decentralisation grants, and sets the amended budget as adopted. It enters into force on 17 September 2024 or the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 17 September.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2024 at € 38,984,106,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2024 vastgesteld op € 38.984.106.000.

36740-A.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across infrastructure articles and giving retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year. The explanatory memorandum describes the changes as technical execution, bookkeeping and audit-driven adjustments, with some project budgets shifted to 2025.
36740-A.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as technical execution, bookkeeping and audit-finding adjustments, with delayed project budgets shifted to 2025 and earlier notified to parliament by letter.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping-type changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
– In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevin dingen opgenomen;

36820-B.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising the commitment and expenditure totals through a first supplementary budget and a September supplementary budget. It also fixes the 2025 commitment amounts for the general and additional allowances and for the integration and decentralisation grants under the Financiële-verhoudingswet, with retroactive effect to 16 September 2025.
q: Is amended as shown in the relevant budget statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36820-XXII.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning (XXII) and the agency budget statement for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf, following the September supplementary budget. It sets out revised appropriations by article, with the amendments taking effect the day after publication and applying retroactively from 16 September 2025.
36820-XXII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to the withdrawn rent freeze, the advice of the Raad van State and the need for revised expenditure and loan drawings, not by any delegation of power.
q: The plan to freeze rents in 2025 and 2026 has been withdrawn, following the advice of the Council of State
Het plan om de huren te bevriezen in 2025 en 2026 is ingetrokken, naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad van State
